title: Whitmore Chrome Shelf
text: Whitmore Chrome Shelf. I purchased this to put under our kitchen sink to create a vertical storage space. I like the adjustability of the product and once assembled is very sturdy. Unfortunately, though I measured THREE times, height, width and depth of cabinets, I didn't take into account the plumbing. The vertical post on the rear right won't go under the pipes without compromising the top shelf. It's in the garage now, with stain and rags and other stuff, so it isn't a complete loss, but now I have to find another product that will accomplish what this was purchased for. This kitchen cabinet is so wide that the pull out drawers plan we originally hoped would work, wasn't an option.
